text:
Viral ChatGPT
Prompt Ideas
Viral Social Media Hook Generator
"You are a viral content strategist for TikTok and Instagram.
Create 15 hook ideas that use curiosity, controversy, or
emotional pull. Each hook should be under 8 words, sound
conversational, and make someone stop scrolling. Provide them
in a table with a short note on why each works.
Scroll-Stopping Caption Bank
"Act as a Gen Z social media copywriter. Write 20 Instagram
captions that sound playful, relatable, and are designed to get
comments. Include a mix of humor, storytelling, and
cliffhangers. Keep each caption under 15 words. Provide 3
relevant emoji suggestions for each."
Viral Video Script Blueprint
"Pretend you are a viral YouTube Shorts creator. Write a 60-
second script that starts with a hook in the first 3 seconds,
builds tension, then delivers a surprising twist at the end.
Format it with scene directions and on-screen text ideas.
Share-Worthy Tweet Thread
"Act as a Twitter growth hacker. Write a 10-tweet thread on a
topic of your choice that is designed to get retweets. Each tweet
should be punchy, under 280 characters, and have a mix of
curiosity, story, and practical value. End with a strong call-to-
action.
Relatable Meme Ideas List
"You are a viral meme strategist for lifestyle brands. Come up
with 15 meme ideas using trending formats. For each idea,
describe the image concept, the text overlay, and why it would
resonate with a specific audience."
SEO-Boosting Clickbait Blog Titles
"Act as a top digital marketer. Generate 25 blog post titles that
are SEO-friendly but also have viral clickbait appeal. Use power
words, numbers, and emotional triggers. Include the target
keyword naturally in each title."
COLLABAI
